Undo cleanup on your TV

Restore the apps and services you switched off during optional cleanup.

  1. Find your recovery file. Use the restore script or list of changes you saved before cleanup. Confirm it belongs to the same TV and cleanup session.
  2. Restore the recorded changes. If you saved a restore script, follow the recovery instructions that came with it. If you saved a list, reverse each recorded change using the same method you used for cleanup. An assistant that helped with setup can use your saved list to walk you through restoring those entries.
  3. Check your TV. Try the remote, streaming apps, HDMI inputs, and casting. If an app still fails, check its entry in the recovery file before making further changes.
Missing the recovery file?

Look for the backup created by your cleanup tool or the record from your original setup session. Use that record to identify which packages to restore.
